meta.name: verify
meta.description: Drive an engine app headlessly in a pty, record a video of the whole verification, and open a summary page (video + timeline + checks) with pixel open.

copy.tagline: 驱动应用自动验证,录制全程视频并打开摘要页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要自动驱动应用运行并留下验证记录视频。
copy.tagline_en: Drive an app headlessly, record its verification, and open a summary page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate app verification and capture a video record

howto.what: Claude会在无头终端中启动并操作应用,录制整个验证过程,并生成、打开带视频、时间线和检查结果的汇总页面。
howto.when: 当用户要求验证引擎应用、编写验证脚本,或需要记录应用运行过程并生成报告时。

say.text: 帮我写一个验证脚本,驱动typing应用,录制视频并生成汇总页
say.note: 将自动执行验证并生成视频和汇总页

say.text: 用verify验证滚轮滚动是否保持光标位置,并打开汇总页面
say.note: 会检查滚动行为并生成带结果的汇总页

say.text: 运行验证,检查所有断言是否通过,并打开summary.html
say.note: 运行后打开验证报告页面

howto.what_en: Claude drives the app in a headless pty, records the whole verification, and generates and opens a summary page with video, timeline, and checks.
howto.when_en: When asked to verify an engine app, write a verification script, or record an app run with a report.

say_en.text: Write a verification script, drive the app, record video, and generate a summary.
say_en.note: Runs the verification and produces video and summary.

say_en.text: Verify that wheel scrolling keeps the cursor anchored, and open the summary.
say_en.note: Checks scrolling and creates a summary with results.

say_en.text: Run the verification, check all assertions pass, and open summary.html.
say_en.note: Opens the verification report after running.
